The files are the source-language baselines of ADR 0006 (performance budgets): node runs them through
../cipher-checksum.js, which was written for this repository. They are kept byte for byte as the
commit has them - do not reformat them, and replace them only as a whole with the files of a newer
commit, updating commit and hashes here.
